name: qarunbook
description: A QA runbook your coding assistant can read and write. Testers raise what breaks; the assistant reads what failed, fixes it, and marks the issue resolved. Bundles the qarunbook MCP server and two skills: /test-checklist builds the plan from the code, /qa-runbook runs the testing.

QARUNBOOK_TOKEN.title: qarunbook token
QARUNBOOK_TOKEN.description: Your personal MCP token, from Connect your AI on qarunbook.com. It acts as you, with your role, so the assistant can do exactly what you can.
